summary.text: Luis Terrazas is a Republican state representative from District 39 who has represented the district since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the New Mexico House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes owning a business in the funeral service industry.

paragraphs.text: For 2025-2026 Luis Terrazas is assigned to the Labor, Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee and the Taxation and Revenue Committee.
In 2023-2024 he served as ranking member of the Local Government, Land Grants and Cultural Affairs Committee.
